extracted.summary: The NSP NEC Merit Scholarship provides financial assistance to meritorious students from the North Eastern Region of India pursuing diploma, degree, postgraduate, M.Phil or Ph.D. programs.
extracted.amount_text:
Diploma: INR 20,000 per annum.
Degree: INR 22,000 per annum.
PG: INR 25,000 per annum.
M.Phil or Ph.D.: INR 30,000 per annum.
extracted.min_percentage_quote: Applicants must have scored a minimum of 60% marks in the qualifying examinations.
extracted.max_family_income_quote: Applicants must have an annual family income of less than INR 8,00,000 from all sources.
extracted.course_levels_quote: Applicants must be enrolled in a diploma, degree or postgraduate course, or be registered in a M.Phil. or Ph.D. program.
extracted.states_quote: Applicants must be an Indian citizen and a permanent resident of Assam, Arunachal Pradesh, Manipur, Meghalaya, Mizoram, Nagaland, Sikkim or Tripura.
